name: init_from_server
description: Start a repository in an empty root, or add server projects to the solution already there. apply defaults to false, so the result is a plan until apply is true. No path argument: it always uses the MCP server root.

projects.description: Server project names to create or add; at least one is required.

apply.description: Write the planned files. The default only returns the plan.

name: projects
description: The solution's ThingWorx projects, their roots, their deploy order and how many entity documents each holds.

name: types
description: Generate editor declarations, type-check every service, or fetch and cache platform declarations. All actions take the workspace lock.

detail.description: Return everything instead of the summary.

outputSchema.description: The three actions answer with different members; `ok` is the one they share.

name: check
description: Run every gate of the solution (line endings, sidecars in sync, formatting, script traps, code order, project validation, declared hooks). With live: true, every service script is also parsed by the ThingWorx server, and an unreachable server fails the check. live defaults to the solution's [gates] live.

detail.description: Return everything instead of the summary.

name: status
description: Compare entities with the server and the recorded baseline: in-sync, local-changed, server-changed, both-changed, not-on-server, or no baseline yet. Lists every entity that needs attention.

entity.description: One entity name, full or its last dotted segment. Name one, or pass all: true.

all.description: Every entity (of the project, if one is named).

project.description: Narrow to one project of the solution.

record.description: Record a baseline for every entity whose two sides agree. Writes .twaco/baselines/<profile>.json under the workspace lock.

detail.description: Return everything instead of the summary.

ancestor.description: An export document inside the solution whose entities stand in for the baseline as the common ancestor, for a workspace without a usable one. Read-only: not with record.

recorded.description:
How many baselines were recorded; null unless asked to record. Counts and verdicts
describe the state after recording, including the matching entities now in-sync.

ancestor.description: The export used as the ancestor instead of the baseline, when one was given.

attention.description: Without detail: only what needs attention.

name: entity_pull
description: Take server-changed entity exports into the repository, extract their sidecars and record their baselines. A dry run unless dry_run is false.

entities.description: Entity names, full or their last dotted segment. Name some, or pass all: true.

all.description: Every server-changed entity. No-baseline differences need explicit names.

name: sync
description: Write sidecars back into their entity XML: service scripts, DataShape fields, mashup content, DataTable configuration. This is how an edit to a script.js takes effect. check: true reports what would change and writes nothing. Takes the workspace lock while it writes.

entity.description: One entity, full name or its last dotted segment. Name one or more (entity, entities), or pass all: true.

entities.description: Several entities, each as entity takes one.

all.description: Every entity (of the project, if one is named).

project.description: Narrow to one project of the solution.

allow_add_remove.description: Add the services and fields only the sidecars have, and remove those only the entity has.

relayout.description: Rewrite every script payload in the configured layout.

name: extract
description: Entity XML to sidecars: service scripts, DataShape fields, mashup content, DataTable configuration. Overwrites the sidecars of the entities chosen; takes the workspace lock.

entity.description: One entity, full name or its last dotted segment. Name one or more (entity, entities), or pass all: true.

entities.description: Several entities, each as entity takes one.

all.description: Every entity (of the project, if one is named).

name: fmt
description: Format every service script sidecar with the built-in formatter. check: true reports which would change and writes nothing.

name: push
description: Import one entity's file to the server. Refuses when the server changed since the last sync, was deleted there, or has no baseline, unless force is true. Reads the entity back and records a baseline only for what the server kept. A dry run unless dry_run is false.

backup.description: With force, save the server's copy under .twaco/backups first (default true); false skips it.

outputSchema.description: A plan and an applied push answer with different members; `entity` and `dry_run` are shared.

name: entity_delete
description: Delete server entities in dependency-safe order. Accepts Collection/Name or a bare name resolved on the server; renamed adds undeleted entity/prefix entries from .twaco/renames.json. allow_repository_defined accepts a repository definition that deployment would recreate; allow_outside_dependents accepts structural dependents outside the delete set; allow_file_repository_data_loss accepts deleting a FileRepository Thing and all its files. A FileRepository delete needs its own acknowledgement. force is deprecated: it means the first two acknowledgements and never FileRepository data loss. A dry run unless dry_run is false; every applied delete is confirmed absent.

entities.description: Entities to delete; may be empty when renamed is true.

force.description: Deprecated: means allow_repository_defined and allow_outside_dependents; never accepts FileRepository data loss.

backup.description: Save the server's copy of every entity under .twaco/backups before deleting (default true); a failed backup deletes nothing.

ledger_marked.description: The date the rename ledger was marked with, when an applied delete changed it.

deprecated.description: Present when the deprecated `force` was used.

outputSchema.description: A plan and an applied delete share every member; `plan` or `applied` says which it was.

name: entity_restore
description: List the backup sets taken before deletes and forced overwrites (no set given), or import one back: all its entities, or the named ones. A dry run unless dry_run is false; each import is confirmed on the server.

set.description: A set id from the listing; omit to list sets.

entities.description: Only these (Collection/Name or a bare name).

outputSchema.description: With no set: the backup sets. With one: what restoring it does, or did.

name: entity_carry
description: Copy run-time, design-time and visibility permissions from renamed (old) entities to the ones that replaced them, mapping principals through the rename ledger. pairs is a flat list [old, new, old, new, ...] of Collection/Name; renamed adds every pending ledger entity. A dry run unless dry_run is false; every write is read back and the ledger marked carried.

pairs.description: Collection/Old, Collection/New, in pairs; may be empty when renamed is true.

detail.description: Also ask the platform for its own difference count.

name: permissions
description: Compare entities' run-time, design-time and visibility permissions (and the instance permissions of a ThingShape or ThingTemplate) in the repository with the server's. An import only adds: it never removes a grant the server has, and never changes the server's allow or deny for a principal it already lists. Each difference is server-only, repository-only or flipped (allow/deny differs). A permission set the entity XML does not declare is not compared. Read-only.

entities.description: Entity names, full or their last dotted segment. Name some, or pass all: true.

all.description: Every entity (of the project, if one is named).

project.description: Narrow to one project of the solution.

name: requirements_init
description: Draft requirements.toml offline from the solution's external entities, Project dependsOn extensions and projects, and platform version. Returns the draft; dry_run defaults to true. Apply creates a new file under the workspace lock and refuses an existing requirements.toml; use requirements_check to see what changed.

name: requirements_check
description: Check requirements.toml against the repository. Undeclared dependencies and lower declared versions block; stale entries are notes. With server true, also verify the platform version, installed extensions, projects and external entities with read-only server requests. Server failures block. Summary first; detail includes every finding and referrer.

name: permissions_init
description: Draft a permissions.toml for each project without one, from what the project grants today, so that permissions_apply then changes nothing but what each draft's notes name: each rule names its roles outright; roles come from the permission helper's RoleGroupsAndOrganizations when the project has one, else from the groups its run-time blocks grant. from_helper takes the grants from the helper's tables instead of the entity XML (a matrix edited in the helper's mashup). An entity with a deny or a non-group principal in its run-time block, or a visibility deny of a role's unit, is left unmanaged, with a note. A dry run (the drafts' text) unless dry_run is false; existing files are never overwritten.

project.description: Narrow to one project of the solution.

from_helper.description: Take the grants from the permission helper's tables, not the entity XML.

name: permissions_audit
description: Check each project's permissions.toml (its root folder) against the entity XML. Errors: run-time or visibility blocks the policy would change (permissions apply writes them), services of a strict entity no rule classifies, a group or user in visibility (the server answers 500), an Organization in run-time permissions. Warnings: principals under a project of the solution that no entity defines, rules or patterns that match nothing. Notes: explicit denies. With server: true (and a profile), also the server against the repository: each entity's permission sets, the permission helper's tables, the policy's platform grants and memberships, and each role's organizational unit. detail lists the grants behind each finding. Read-only.

project.description: Narrow to one project of the solution.

server.description:
Also compare the server (read-only): entity permissions, helper tables, platform grants,
memberships and role units.

detail.description: Every grant behind each finding.

name: permissions_apply
description: Write each project's permissions.toml into its entity XML: the run-time block of each Thing, the instance run-time block of each ThingShape and ThingTemplate, and the role principals of each visibility block. Only blocks that differ change; the rest of each file is untouched. Refused while a strict entity has a service no rule classifies. remaining lists audit findings the write does not settle. A dry run unless dry_run is false; the files are written in one transaction. Deploy them, then permissions_push, since an import never removes a grant.

project.description: Narrow to one project of the solution.

detail.description: Every grant each file gains or loses.

name: permissions_push
description: Make the server's permission sets exactly the repository's: every differing run-time, design-time or visibility set is written whole and read back. Removes server-only grants and corrects flipped allow/deny, which an import cannot do. A set the entity XML does not declare is never written. A dry run unless dry_run is false; an applied push records the baseline of each pushed entity that then matches the server. With platform: true (and no entities), instead add the permissions.toml [[platform]] grants and memberships the server lacks (what DeployComponent does on entities the project does not own); nothing is ever removed.

entities.description: Entity names, full or their last dotted segment. Name some, or pass all: true.

all.description: Every entity (of the project, if one is named).

platform.description:
Instead of entities, add the policies' [[platform]] grants and memberships the server
lacks; nothing is removed.

project.description: Narrow to one project of the solution.

recorded.description: How many baselines an applied push recorded.

outputSchema.description: Entities and the platform grants answer with different members; `ok` and `applied` are shared.

name: db_run
description: Run one SQL script as an atomic SQLCommand through a throwaway Database Thing. Plans by default and shows the SQL and sanitized connection target; pass dry_run: false to execute.

file.description: A UTF-8 SQL file relative to the solution; give file or sql.

sql.description: Inline SQL; give sql or file.

thing.description: Database Thing; otherwise resolve the one in the solution.

no_transaction.description: Prefix COMMIT; for statements such as CREATE DATABASE.

result.description: The server's reply; a query adds `total_rows` and `columns` to it.

outputSchema.description: What `db_run` and `db_query` report: the SQL, where it ran and, once run, what it returned.

name: db_query
description: Run read-only SQLQuery through a throwaway Database Thing. Returns columns and the first 20 rows unless detail is true.

file.description: A UTF-8 SQL file relative to the solution; give file or sql.

sql.description: Inline SQL; give sql or file.

thing.description: Database Thing; otherwise resolve the one in the solution.

detail.description: Return everything instead of the summary.

result.description: The server's reply; a query adds `total_rows` and `columns` to it.

outputSchema.description: What `db_run` and `db_query` report: the SQL, where it ran and, once run, what it returned.

name: datatable_copy
description: Copy the rows of one DataTable into the DataTable that replaced it, mapping fields by name, by the rename ledger, or by map ({old: new}). Refuses unmapped fields (unless drop_unmapped), type changes, and a non-empty target (unless append). A dry run unless dry_run is false; the target is read back and compared. Each row's source, tags and timestamp are not carried.

name: db_clean
description: Find, and with dry_run false delete, the temporary ZZ.Twaco.Sql.* Database Things an interrupted db_run or db_query left on the server. Only names twaco generates, on Database Things, are touched.

name: deploy
description: Deploy the solution: the gates (requirements checked against the server), one bundle per project in dependency order, every script parsed by the server (fails closed), a conflict check per entity, then import, read-back, and the project's deploy and post-import services. A dry run (a plan) unless dry_run is false.

force.description: Overwrite entities the server changed since the last sync.

backup.description: With force, save the server's copy of each overwritten entity under .twaco/backups first (default true).

only.description: Only these entities; post-import services are skipped.

changed_since.description: Select entities whose source file or sidecars changed since this Git revision.

exclude.description: Remove matching Collection/Name selectors from the selected entities.

skip_checks.description:
Skip the gates, the server requirements check among them. The server's script parse
during the deploy still runs.

redeploy_blocks.description:
Run each building block's deploy step ([project.deploy] framework = true) even when the
Solution Framework has the block Configured.

detail.description: Return everything instead of the summary.

server_owned.description: Each existing entity whose import preserves server-owned parts, with its part labels.

parts.description: Owned parts the import carries from the server.

clears.description: Owned parts holding an encrypted value, which the import clears; a deploy hook sets them.

stage.description: Absent when the deploy completed; otherwise where it stopped.

agents_narrowed_first.description: Agents imported before the bundles without the items the deploy's namespaces drop.

building_blocks.description: Each building block's deploy step: project, entry_point, state before, runs, configured.

localization.description: The localization tables a whole-solution deploy carries: each table that differs.

entities_deployed.description: With stage `localization`: whether the entities were imported before the tables failed.

outputSchema.description:
A deploy that ran, one the gates stopped (`blocking_gates` says what each found), and one the server refused each answer
differently; `ok` and the stage it reached tell them apart.

name: adopt_report
description: Compare a designer's or backend collaborator's Composer <Entities> export with the repository, three-way against its base. Returns which UI and backend entities/services are theirs, stale or conflicting. Writes nothing; reverts is what `twaco adopt --fail-on-revert` fails on.

export.description: A designer's or backend collaborator's export, absolute or relative to the solution root.

base.description: The collaborator's starting export, recorded handoff, or git revision.

only.description: Limit comparison to designer-owned UI or backend collections.

entity.description: Only entities whose name contains one of these.

detail.description: Return everything instead of the summary.

suggest_base.description: List recorded handoffs ranked for this export, then return without a report.

name: adopt_apply
description: Apply a designer's or backend collaborator's export, three-way against its base: writes selected UI content and safe backend entity/service changes; conflicts need take. Backend changes are folded into entity XML; mashup sidecars may need sync. Takes the workspace lock.

export.description: A designer's or backend collaborator's export, absolute or relative to the solution root.

base.description: The collaborator's starting export, recorded handoff, or git revision.

only.description: Limit comparison to designer-owned UI or backend collections.

take.description: Resolve named conflicts by taking the collaborator's or repository's version.

target.description: An entity or Entity.Service; `ui` with theirs takes every UI conflict and unknown.

applied.description: What was written, one line each.

unmapped.description:
Literal arguments and defaults of retyped service parameters that the new base type does
not take: left as written, for a person to change.

name: handoff
description: List recorded collaborator handoffs, or record delivered <Entities> exports as a future three-way adopt base. Record is a dry run unless dry_run is false; applying copies files under .twaco/handoffs and takes the workspace lock.

files.description: Export paths required for action record, absolute or relative to the solution root.

dry_run.description: Record only when false; record plans by default.

outputSchema.description: list answers with `handoffs`; record with its plan, or the handoff it recorded.

name: rename
description: Rename one entity, a dotted project/building-block prefix, a DataShape field, a declared service, one service parameter, or a configuration table. A dry run unless dry_run is false; an apply takes the workspace lock. The result carries a plan_digest: pass it back with dry_run false to apply exactly the plan that was reviewed.

scope.description: Entity full name; required for kind field, service or table.

service.description: Service name; required for kind param and refused otherwise.

sql.description: Write the database migration script when the rename touches DBConnection tables (into sql/ or sql_dir). Such a rename is refused unless sql or no_sql is given.

sql_dir.description: Folder for the migration script, relative to the solution; implies sql.

no_sql.description: The DBConnection tables are not in use: write no script.

plan_digest.description: The plan_digest a dry run returned. With dry_run false, the rename is refused (nothing written) unless the plan is still exactly that one.
Pass it back with dry_run false to apply exactly this plan.

name: move_member
description: Move or copy a service or a property from one Thing, template or shape to another in the repository: the definition (and a service's implementation and sidecar) is lifted out byte for byte and re-indented where it lands. Refuses a name the target, its ancestors or its descendants already use; reports the callers that stop resolving when the target is not something the source inherits; leave_delegate keeps a service on the source that calls the moved one (a Thing target). A dry run unless dry_run is false; an apply takes the workspace lock.

from.description: The entity the member is on.

new_name.description: A new name on the target.

as.description: The member's name where it lands.

callers.description: The references that stop resolving: how many, and the first few.

name: new_building_block
description: Create a new building block in the repository, as the building-block framework's Create New Building Block does on a server: its project, EntryPoint template and Thing, Management shape, Manager template and Thing (not for an abstract block), default and admin groups and organization, as files, plus the project in twaco.toml. The files match what the framework produced on a server. The permission helper and the ui and test types are not created. A dry run unless dry_run is false; an apply takes the workspace lock.

name.description: The block's name with its namespace, such as Acme.Orders.

parent.description: The abstract block an implementation implements.

management_shape.description: An implementation may leave out its Management_TS.

root.description: The project's folder, relative to the solution; default the block's name.

base_extension.description: PTC.Base:<version>; default what another project of the solution declares.

name: entity_new
description: Create a ThingWorx entity as a repository XML file: Projects, Groups, common Things, data Things, media, styles, states, menus, themes, and Networks. A new Project also appends its project declaration to twaco.toml. DataShape and DataTable creation also writes their managed sidecar. A dry run unless dry_run is false; apply takes the workspace lock and writes every file or none.

tool.description:
mcp-namespace: `name=Provider.Service` tools; prefix the provider `Thing:`,
`ThingTemplate:` or `ThingShape:` to name one outside the solution.

describe.description:
mcp-namespace: `name=text` descriptions; a tool or service resource defaults to its
service's description, a prompt to its text. ThingWorx refuses an empty one.

skill.description: ai-agent: `Repository:/path` skill folders holding a SKILL.md.

instructions_file.description: ai-agent: a file holding the instructions.

agent_description.description: ai-agent: the description the assistant routes questions by.

display_name.description: ai-agent: the name the assistant shows (default: the entity name).

runs.description: The first line of the script it runs.

name: network
description: List repository Networks, show an asset hierarchy (from the server when server is true), or diff repository and server connections. Show returns the same data as network show --json; its tree is limited to 200 rows unless detail is true. Read-only.

profile.description: Server profile for diff, and for show when server is true.

server.description: Read `show` from the server rather than the repository.

outputSchema.description:
`network` list or show.  The action determines whether `networks` or the hierarchy members
are populated.

name: block
description: List the solution's Solution Framework building blocks (each a project with a <project>.EntryPoint Thing), or show one: type, version, display name, entry point, manager, organization, groups, permission helper, dependencies. With server true, also the framework's view from the server: its version, state (Configured, Not Configured, Error) and deploy order, notes on what differs, and for show the parameters DeployComponent takes. Read-only.

inputSchema.description: `block`: the solution's building blocks, or one of them.

block.description: For show: the block (its project), or the end of its name.

server.description:
Add the framework's view from the server: version, state, deploy order and, for show,
the parameters DeployComponent takes.

profile.description: The server profile, with server true.

deploy_parameters.description: Each with name, types, description and optional.

deploy_parameters_error.description: Why the entry point could not say its parameters.

outputSchema.description:
list: `blocks`, each the repository's block, or with server true {block, server, notes};
show: `block`, and with server true `server`, `notes` and `deploy_parameters`.

name: block_version
description: Raise (bump patch, minor or major) or set a building block's version: the entry point's componentVersion and the Project's packageVersion, together and nothing else. A bump is refused while the two disagree; set writes both. A dry run unless dry_run is false; an apply takes the workspace lock and writes both files or neither.

inputSchema.description: `block_version`: raise or set a block's version.

block.description: The block (its project), or the end of its name.

bump.description: Raise the version; give this or set.

set.description: The version to write, major.minor.patch; give this or bump.

dry_run.description: Plan only when true (the default); false writes both files.

files.description: The Project's file and the entry point's, relative to the solution.

name: network_write
description: Add, move or remove a Network connection, import an RFC 4180 asset CSV, or pull server connections into the repository. An import can create Things from repository or platform templates. A dry run unless dry_run is false; apply writes every created Thing and the Network XML in one transaction.

name: entity_edit
description: Change an existing entity in the repository, as Composer would: add, change or remove a property of a Thing, ThingTemplate or ThingShape (a persistent one also writes the stored value of every Thing that has it), add a script service (a definition and its sidecars, as sync would) or remove one with its sidecars and run-time permissions, add or remove a script subscription, implement or stop implementing a ThingShape, change a timer's or scheduler's settings, given keys of a style, a MediaEntity's image, a menu's items, or a StateDefinition's states. Removing or retyping a property, or removing a service, something still uses is refused unless force. A dry run unless dry_run is false; apply takes the workspace lock and writes every file or none.

entity.description: The entity to change: its name, or Collection/Name.

name.description: The property, subscription or service name.

type.description: The property base type: required for property_add; for property_set a new type.

persistent.description: Whether the property is persistent; absent leaves it (property_set).

units.description: The property units; empty clears them.

data_shape.description: The DataShape of an INFOTABLE property.

force.description: Remove or retype a property something still uses; what uses it comes back as warnings.

event.description: subscription_add: the event, such as DataChange, ThingStart, Timer or an event the source defines.

source.description: subscription_add: the Thing subscribed to; absent is the entity itself.

source_property.description: subscription_add: the property a DataChange subscription watches.

then.description: subscription_add / service_add: the script (service_add: absent means an empty body).

params.description: service_add: parameters in declaration order, each `name:TYPE[:DataShape]`.

returns.description: service_add: the result `TYPE[:DataShape]`; absent means NOTHING.

private.description: service_add: whether Composer hides the service from normal callers.

every.description: timer_set: the update rate, as milliseconds or with ms, s, m or h.

cron.description: scheduler_set: a six- or seven-field Quartz cron string.

run_as.description: timer_set / scheduler_set: the user its events run as.

enabled.description: timer_set / scheduler_set: enable or disable it on startup.

background.description: style_set: a #rrggbb or rgba() color; empty clears it.

line_style.description: style_set: solid, dashed, dotted or none.

bold.description: style_set: bold text on or off.

italic.description: style_set: italic text on or off.

underline.description: style_set: underline text on or off.

text_size.description: style_set: xsmall, small, normal, large, xlarge or xxlarge.

image.description: style_set: a MediaEntity; empty clears it.

file.description: media_set: the PNG, JPEG, GIF or SVG file.

mashup.description: menu_item_add: the mashup the item opens.

before.description: menu_item_add: put the item before this title; absent is last.

is_default.description: menu_item_add: make it the default item.

state.description: state_set: the states in order, each `<comparator><value>=<label>[;style key:value...]`; the last may be `*=<label>`.

item_kind.description: mcp_add: tool, service-resource, file-resource or prompt.

spec.description:
mcp_add: `name=Provider.Service`, `name=Repository:/path` or `name=text`; agent_allow and
agent_disallow: `Namespace` or `Namespace=item,item`; agent_taxonomy_add:
`TemplateOrShape[=alias, alias]`; agent_skill_add and agent_skill_remove:
`Repository:/path`. mcp_remove and agent_taxonomy_remove take `name`; mcp_add takes the
item's `description`.

resolver.description: agent_set: the HierarchyResolver Thing; empty clears it.

instructions_file.description: agent_set: a file holding the instructions.

agent_description.description: agent_set: the description the assistant routes questions by.

display_name.description: agent_set: the name the assistant shows.

name: mashup_new
description: Create a ThingWorx 10.2 responsive mashup from an embedded layout template, with its entity file and managed content.json and custom.css sidecars. template is a name or alias (blank by default); mashup_templates lists the slots where mashup_add can place widgets. Menu templates require primary_menu and may use secondary_menu. master puts its page container in the template's master slot. A dry run unless dry_run is false; an apply takes the workspace lock and writes every file or none.

project.description: The project it belongs to; may be left out when the solution has one project.

template.description: An embedded layout template name or alias; default `blank`.

primary_menu.description: The INFOTABLE service result used as a sidebar's primary menu.

secondary_menu.description: The INFOTABLE service result used as a sidebar's secondary menu.

theme.description: A StyleTheme in the solution; default PTC Convergence Theme.

master.description: A master mashup, with a page container filling the center.

params.description: Parameter declarations as `name:TYPE[:DIRECTION]`; INFOTABLE is not supported here.

name: mashup_templates
description: List embedded responsive mashup templates, or with name one template's slot tree. Read-only; no server.

name.description: One template name or alias; omit to list every embedded template.

outputSchema.description: The templates, or with a name one template's slot tree.

name: mashup_add
description: Add a catalogue widget to an existing responsive mashup. With no placement it goes in center. A widget beside another goes in the same row or column when that container runs that way; otherwise both get containers of their own in a new row or column. A widget that can fill fills only a container it is alone in. A dry run unless dry_run is false; an apply takes the workspace lock and writes the entity and managed content sidecar together.

widget.description: A catalogue widget type or alias.

in.description: Put the widget in this responsive container.

properties.description: Simple catalogue default properties to set by exact property name.

inputs.description: An expression's or validator's inputs as `name:TYPE`.

child.description: A contained mashup: the child and its visible parameters.

outputSchema.description: What `mashup_add` and `mashup_add_contained` report: the widget placed and where.

name: mashup_add_contained
description: Add a repository mashup as a contained mashup. Its visible child parameters become container properties; set supplies static values for visible input parameters. With no placement it goes in center. A dry run unless dry_run is false; an apply takes the workspace lock and writes the entity and managed content sidecar together.

mashup.description: The mashup that will hold the contained child.

child.description: The repository mashup the container shows.

set.description: Static values for visible IN or BOTH child parameters.

child.description: A contained mashup: the child and its visible parameters.

outputSchema.description: What `mashup_add` and `mashup_add_contained` report: the widget placed and where.

name: mashup_bind
description: Add one data binding to an existing mashup. Addresses are exactly those mashup describe prints: ui:<widget>.<Property>, mashup:<Parameter>, and data:<Entity>.<Service> with an optional [as alias], [SelectedRows], field or parameter. A missing Thing call is created; templates and shapes need an existing call. A dry run unless dry_run is false; an apply takes the workspace lock and writes the entity and managed content sidecar together.

from.description: A source address as `mashup describe` prints it.

to.description: A target address as `mashup describe` prints it.

new_source.description: The data call the binding created, when it created one.

name: mashup_on
description: Run a data call or widget service when one mashup event fires. Triggers are ui:<widget>.<Event>, mashup:Loaded, or an existing data:<Entity>.<Service>[as alias].ServiceInvokeCompleted, AllDataChanged or SelectedRowsChanged; handlers are data calls or widget services. A missing Thing handler call is created; templates and shapes need an existing call. A dry run unless dry_run is false; an apply takes the workspace lock and writes the entity and managed content sidecar together.

event.description: A UI, mashup or existing data event address.

invoke.description: A data call or widget service address.

name: widgets
description: List or search the embedded ThingWorx 10.2 widget catalogue (type, Composer label, aliases, container, whether bindable), or with widget, one widget's bindable properties with base type and direction (in, out, in/out), its events and services. Read-only; no server.

widget.description: One widget type or alias; omit to list the catalogue.

search.description: Narrow the list by type, Composer label or alias.

outputSchema.description: The catalogue, or with a widget that widget's contract.

name: mashup_param
description: Add, change or remove a mashup parameter. It keeps the entity definition, content parameter definitions, parameter property maps and every containing mashupcontainer cache in step. A dry run unless dry_run is false; apply writes all affected mashups in one transaction.

outputSchema.description: What `mashup_param` and `mashup_event` report: a parameter and every mashup it touched.

name: mashup_recipe
description: Write one recipe: the wiring real mashups repeat, in one edit. enable-when/show-when (widget, condition, inputs name=address: an expression into Disabled/Visible), text (widget, expression, inputs: a label's computed text), message (after a data call: say or from, kind info|warning|error), confirm (widget, then, title, say), popup (widget or on, target mashup, window modal-popup|popup|replace|new, size WxH, title, pass name=address, reload handler on close), close-after (after a data call the popup closes itself), auto-refresh (then data call, every seconds or interval address), validate (widget or on, condition, inputs, then, else_say), chart (widget, data, x, value for a pie, kind), columns (widget, columns field[:Title[:width]], data), picker (widget, data, x display field, value, selected). A dry run unless dry_run is false; an apply takes the workspace lock and writes the entity and managed content sidecar together.

recipe.description: enable-when, show-when, text, message, confirm, popup, close-after, auto-refresh or validate.

mashup.description: The mashup to write it in.

widget.description: The widget it is about, or the one whose click triggers it.

inputs.description: `name=address` inputs of the condition or expression.

data.description: The service result a chart, grid or picker shows.

x.description: A chart's category (pie: label) field, a picker's display field.

value.description: A pie's or picker's value field.

selected.description: What a picker's selection is bound from.

name: mashup_event
description: Give a mashup an event its parents can react to. ThingWorx has no contained-mashup events, so, as real mashups do, it adds a NUMBER parameter (BOTH; every parent's copy refreshed) set to the time by an expression the given trigger evaluates. A parent reacts with mashup_on and event ui:<container>.<name>, which wires an events router. A dry run unless dry_run is false; apply writes all affected mashups in one transaction.

mashup.description: The mashup that fires the event.

name.description: The event's name, which becomes a NUMBER parameter.

when.description: The event in this mashup that fires it, as mashup_on's event takes it.

outputSchema.description: What `mashup_param` and `mashup_event` report: a parameter and every mashup it touched.

name: mashup_validate
description: Validate mashups in the repository without the server: structure, containers that hold both containers and widgets, an id_index below the widgets' numbers, bindings and events naming a widget, data source or call the mashup lacks, bindings against a catalogue widget's contract (direction, unknown property), events naming an event or service the widget lacks, bindings with several property maps, and contained-mashup parameter drift. Give mashup, or all. Read-only.

mashup.description: One mashup's name; omit it with all.

name: mashup_describe
description: Describe a mashup in the repository without its XML: the widget tree (ids, types, row/column containers, which widget fills its container, text and [[tokens]]); each service it calls, with what sets each declared parameter (a binding's source, static, or unbound); each binding, one row per property map, warning when a binding has more than one (the runtime applies only the first); and each event. Addresses are those mashup bind and on take: ui:<widget>.<Property>, data:<Entity>.<Service>[.<Parameter>], mashup:<Parameter>. Read-only.

name: reproject
description: Move entities to another project of the solution: their projectName, and their files under that project's root (sidecars stay). The plan names each reference the move puts outside the deploy order, with the depends_on that allows it. A dry run unless dry_run is false; an apply takes the workspace lock and writes every file or none.

entities.description: The entities to move: `Name`, or `Collection/Name` when a name is in two collections.

deploy_order.description: References the move puts outside the deploy order.

name: retemplate
description: Change a Thing's template (or a template's base template) and/or the shapes it implements, in the repository. The plan lists what the entity and everything inheriting it gains and loses, the stored property values and configuration-table rows left with no definition, and the references to a lost member; such a loss is refused unless accept_loss is true. A dry run unless dry_run is false; an apply takes the workspace lock.

entity.description: The Thing or template to change.

template.description: The new template (a Thing) or base template (a template).

needs_accept_loss.description: The losses that refuse the change unless accept_loss is true.

name: config_table
description: List a Thing's configuration tables, read one on the server, diff it against the entity XML in the repository, compare it with a backup, back it up to a new file in the solution (a backup is never overwritten), or restore it from such a backup. restore is a dry run unless dry_run is false; it refuses a backup of another Thing or table, and reads the table back.

table.description: The table; list (the Thing's tables) needs none.

backup.description: backup: a new file to write, relative to the solution (under .twaco/backups/ git ignores it; a table can hold secrets); an existing one is never replaced. restore and compare: the file a backup wrote, inside the solution.

detail.description: Return everything instead of the summary.

matching.description: `key`, or `position` when the table has no key or rows share one.

outputSchema.description: Each action answers with different members; `thing` and `table` are shared.

name: logs
description: Read a server log: ApplicationLog, ScriptLog, CommunicationLog, ConfigurationLog or SecurityLog. Newest first. A summary first (counts by level, top origins, repeated messages, the newest entries); detail: true lists every entry. truncated: true means the limit was reached.

log.description: ApplicationLog, ScriptLog, CommunicationLog, ConfigurationLog or SecurityLog.

since.description: How far back, ending now: a duration such as 90s, 15m, 2d or 1h30m. Not with from/to.

from.description: ISO-8601 with Z or an offset (2026-10-01T06:37:00Z); without one it is in the local time zone of the machine running twaco. Or `now`.

grep.description: Entries whose message contains this text.

regex.description: A Java regex that must match the whole message. Not with grep.

detail.description: Return everything instead of the summary.

name: log_level
description: Read a server log's level and its subloggers' levels, or change one. ScriptLog at WARN records no logger.info or logger.debug from scripts; lower it while debugging, then put it back. A change is the whole server's and a dry run unless dry_run is false; the result says how to undo it.

log.description: ApplicationLog, ScriptLog, CommunicationLog, ConfigurationLog or SecurityLog.

level.description: Set this level. Omit, with reset false, to only read.

sublogger.description: A class or package within the log, such as com.thingworx.

reset.description: Put the sublogger (or, without one, every sublogger) back to the log's level.

outputSchema.description: A read answers with `levels`; a change with what it does, or did, and how to undo it.

name: repo
description: Read the server's file repositories: list them, list a folder (recursive: true for everything below), get a text file's content, or compare the tree kept in source control (filerepository/<repo>/) with the server's (same, differs, local-only, remote-only; equal sizes are compared by SHA-256). Read-only.

repository.description: A FileRepository Thing, such as SystemRepository. Not for list.

path.description: ls: a folder (default /); get: a file, such as Thumbnails/a.png.

detail.description: Return everything instead of the summary.

outputSchema.description: Each action answers with different members; `ok` is the one they share.

name: repo_write
description: Change a file repository: put (upload text, or a file of the solution), mkdir, rm (a file, or a folder; recursive: true to delete one that holds anything), mv (a file), or push/pull the tree kept in source control. A dry run unless dry_run is false. Nothing existing is replaced without overwrite: true; applied changes are read back.

action.description: push/pull: the whole tree filerepository/<repo>/ to or from the server; neither deletes.

path.description: put/mkdir/rm: the repository path; mv: the source.

text.description: put: the content, as UTF-8 text.

local.description: put: a file of the solution to upload instead, relative to the solution root.

local_copy.description: mv, rm: what happened to the copy under filerepository/

name: localization
description: Compare the solution's localization table files with the server: same, differs, local-only and server-only tokens, plus problems that would block a push. Read-only; detail: true lists tokens and problems.

table.description: Only one localization table, by its table name.

detail.description: Include each differing token and problem rather than only counts.

compared.description:
With detail: the tokens that are not the same. Differing tokens carry `different`,
`local`, and `server`.

name: localization_write
description: Pull localization tables into the solution, push local tables (and read them back), or create, set or remove local tokens. A dry run unless dry_run is false. push imports tokens without deleting any; prune: true deletes server tokens no local file has.

table.description: new: table name; set/remove: optionally limit the action to this table.

outputSchema.description: Pull and the local edits answer with `files`; push with `tables`.

name: users
description: The test users twaco.toml declares ([[test.user]]) on the server: whether each exists, signs in with the profile's test_password, and is in its groups. Read-only.

name: users_write
description: Create the missing test users, the [test] project and their group memberships (seed), or delete the test users (delete). The profile must say allow_test_users = true; seed also needs its test_password, which is never returned. A dry run unless dry_run is false.

profile.description: Server profile name. It must say `allow_test_users = true`.

name: appkey
description: Create an application key that acts as a user (create; a dry run unless dry_run is false), or read an existing one (show). It always gets an expiration (default 30d; the server's own default is a day). The key itself is returned only with show: true, and written as a profile's app_key only with save. Delete one with entity_delete ApplicationKeys/<name>.

user.description: create: the user the key acts as.

expires.description: create: when it expires: 30d (the default), 12h, a date (midnight UTC) or an RFC 3339 timestamp.

project.description: create: the project the key belongs to.

whitelist.description: create: addresses or ranges the key may be used from; empty means any.

save.description: Write the key as app_key of this profile file, which must exist.

show.description: Return the key itself in the result.

dry_run.description: create: true plans and sends nothing. show reads the server whatever it says.

outputSchema.description: A planned or created key, or one read back. `key` is the key itself, only when asked for.

name: test
description: The service cases of tests/*.toml, each called as each of its test users and expecting a status (and optionally rows). A dry run lists and checks the cases; dry_run false calls them, which may change the server, and needs allow_test_users = true in the profile.

filters.description: Keep the cases whose name, service or file contains one of these.

profile.description: Server profile name. It must say `allow_test_users = true` to run the cases.

dry_run.description: True lists and checks the cases; false calls them, which may change the server.

outputSchema.description: A dry run lists the cases; a run answers with counts and each call.

name: extensions
description: The server's extension packages: list them, or show one (its extensions, and which are in use). Read-only.

outputSchema.description: list answers with `packages`; show with one package and its extensions.

name: ext_check
description: Check a Java ThingWorx extension project offline, before it is built or uploaded: metadata.xml against the Java source (classes it names, ThingTemplates' thingPackage), the jars JarResources lists, each Widget's ide and runtime files, packageVersion against extension.properties, duplicate services, properties or events (inherited ones included), and base types. Notes say what may be fine but cannot be proven (a class only in a jar, a DataShape from elsewhere, a class nothing declares). Needs no solution or server; root is the project folder.

root.description:
The extension project's folder, absolute or relative to the solution; omit for the
solution folder itself.

findings.description: Each with file, line (0: the whole file), rule and message.

outputSchema.description: A Java extension project's findings, offline.

name: ext_build
description: Build a ThingWorx extension project's package zip and read it back: a package.json widget project runs its build script (installing its dependencies the first time), a Java project its Gradle wrapper, Gradle or Ant (Gradle with --no-daemon), and a project with neither a build nor Java sources is packed by twaco (metadata.xml, ui/, Entities/, Localization/, lib/*.jar under lib/common/). Returns the zip, its package and version, the widgets and entities its metadata.xml declares, and files it names that the zip lacks. ext_check runs first. The project must be inside the solution.

root.description:
The extension project's folder, relative to the solution and inside it; omit for the
solution folder itself.

passed.description: The zip holds every file its metadata.xml names.

build.description: The commands run, or "packed by twaco".

outputSchema.description: What ext_build made: the commands run, the zip, what its metadata.xml declares.

name: ext_new
description: Lay out a new ThingWorx extension project. Java (default), as the Eclipse plugin's project wizard did: settings.gradle, a build.gradle that makes the importable zip (build/distributions/<name>.zip), extension.properties, configfiles/metadata.xml, .gitignore, the Java package folder, given an Extension SDK (sdk, or TWACO_SDK) its jars in twx-lib/, and when applied the Gradle wrapper (with Gradle installed). widget: a package.json widget project as the ThingWorx widget template lays it out: TypeScript IDE and runtime widgets on typescriptwebpacksupport and an esbuild script that writes zip/<name>-prod-v<version>.zip. The folder must be inside the solution, and missing or empty. A dry run unless dry_run is false; applied, ext_check's report is returned.

folder.description: The folder to create, relative to the solution and inside it; default: the name.

sdk.description: The Extension SDK zip or folder whose jars go into twx-lib/; default TWACO_SDK.

widget.description:
A package.json widget project (TypeScript widgets, esbuild) rather than a Java one;
package and sdk do not apply, and min_thingworx defaults to 9.0.0.

files.description: Each with path and action (create, or update for metadata.xml).

check.description: When applied: ext_check's report on the result.

wrapper.description: When applied to a Gradle project: the wrapper command run, or why it was not added.

outputSchema.description: The files `ext_new` or `ext_add` writes, or wrote.

name: ext_add
description: Add to a Java ThingWorx extension project: a thing-template (Java class extending Thing with its base template, plus its ThingPackage), a thing-shape or resource (Java class), a widget (ui/<name>/ ide and runtime JS and CSS) or a jar (copied into lib/), each with its metadata.xml entry; the first Java class also lists the jar the build makes. metadata.xml keeps its formatting. The project and a jar must be inside the solution. A dry run unless dry_run is false; applied, ext_check's report is returned.

inputSchema.description: `ext_add`: one thing added to a Java extension project.

name.description:
The entity or widget name; for a jar, the file to copy into lib/, relative to the
solution and inside it.

root.description:
The extension project's folder, relative to the solution and inside it; omit for the
solution folder itself.

package.description:
thing-template, thing-shape, resource: the Java package; default the one metadata.xml's
classes use.

base.description: thing-template: its base template; default GenericThing.

files.description: Each with path and action (create, or update for metadata.xml).

check.description: When applied: ext_check's report on the result.

wrapper.description: When applied to a Gradle project: the wrapper command run, or why it was not added.

outputSchema.description: The files `ext_new` or `ext_add` writes, or wrote.

name: ext_deploy
description: Deploy one of the solution's Java extensions (an [[extension]] in twaco.toml): ext_check it, run its Gradle wrapper, Gradle or Ant build, find the package zip under build/ or zip/, and have the server validate it; with dry_run false install it and confirm the server lists every entity its metadata.xml declares. The server skips a version it has, so a change needs bump (patch, minor or major), which writes the raised packageVersion into metadata.xml and extension.properties and puts it back if the build or install fails. An upgrade of a package with Java code is queued by the server for its next restart, and is reported as queued.

extension.description: An [[extension]] entry's name or root; omit when there is one.

bump.description:
Raise packageVersion first (written only when dry_run is false); the server skips a
version it has.

build.description: Run the project's Gradle or Ant build first; false sends the newest package zip it has.

inputSchema.description: `ext_deploy`: build one of the solution's Java extensions and validate or install it.

ok.description: False when the installed package does not list an entity metadata.xml declares.

extension.description: The [[extension]] entry, and its folder relative to the solution.

version.description: The version sent: the bumped one once applied.

installed.description: The server's version, when it has the package.

bump.description: `x.y.z -> x.y.z'`: done when applied, else what dry_run false would do.

zip.description: The package zip, relative to the solution.

validated.description: Whether the server validated the zip; not while it carries the installed version.

queued.description: Installed at the server's next restart.

missing.description: Entities metadata.xml declares that the installed package does not list.

outputSchema.description: What `ext_deploy` built and sent.

name: extension_write
description: Import an extension package zip of the solution, or remove an installed package. A dry run unless dry_run is false: an import is then only validated by the server, which installs nothing. A removal is refused while the package is in use.

zip.description: import: the package zip, relative to the solution root.

name: bundle
description: The solution's configured bundle, the one importable XML that [bundle] in twaco.toml names: whether it is current, out of date or missing (dry run, as `twaco bundle --check`), or with dry_run false rebuilt from the repository. notes name references to entities the bundle leaves out. package builds a release bundle into a file you name instead.

backend_only.description: Leave out the collections [bundle] ui_collections names (a designer's mashups and media).

changed_since.description: Select entities whose source file or sidecars changed since this Git revision.

exclude.description: Remove matching Collection/Name selectors from the selected entities.

out.description: Write or check this bundle path inside the solution instead of [bundle]'s dist target.

profile.description: Apply this profile's mashup patches from twaco.toml; without it, none apply.

handoff.description: Record the rebuilt bundle as this collaborator handoff; only with dry_run false.

dry_run.description: Only say whether the configured bundle is current, as `twaco bundle --check` does.

entities.description: When the bundle was built: current or written.

name: search
description: Search the server's entities, as Composer's Spotlight box does: by text found in a name or description (any case; a * makes it a pattern), entity types and project, and with modified_since only what changed since then, newest first: what someone changed on the server since the last deploy. Read-only. Each result is Collection/Name with type, project, description and when it last changed, ready for entity_get or export. more says the limit cut the list; note says when a project does not exist. An unknown type is refused, because the server would otherwise search everything.

text.description: Text found anywhere in an entity's name or description, in any case; with a * it is a pattern instead (*_DS). Absent: every entity.

types.description: Entity types, singular or as collections (Thing, ThingTemplates, Mashup, ...). An unknown one is refused.

modified_since.description: Only entities changed at or after this: a duration back from now (1d, 12h, 30m), a date (midnight UTC) or an RFC 3339 timestamp.

sort.description: name: A to Z; modified: newest change first. Absent: modified with modified_since, name without. With modified_since the limit keeps the newest, whatever the order.

name: entity_get
description: One entity's XML as the server has it: Collection/Name reaches any entity on the server, a bare name one in the repository. Read-only; nothing is written. A long entity is cut at max_chars (truncated says so); export with action entity writes it whole to a file.

entity.description: Collection/Name for any entity on the server (Things/My.Thing, Resources/EntityServices), or a bare name for one in the repository.

max_chars.description: The most XML characters returned; a longer entity is cut, and export writes it whole to a file.

name: export
description: Export from the server as Composer's Import/Export does: an entity (Collection/Name), a collection (optionally one project's part), or a whole project, as one XML file written inside the solution; or the source-control layout of a project, collection or tags into a file repository folder or zip (a dry run unless dry_run is false).

out.description: entity/collection/project: the file to write, relative to the solution root.

zip.description: source_control: write a zip of this name instead of a folder.

outputSchema.description: An XML export answers with the file it wrote; a source-control export with its plan.

name: package
description: Package the repository for release, offline, into a file inside the solution: a bundle (one importable XML; part all, backend or frontend), a source-control zip (<Project>/<Collection>/<Name>.xml), or an extension zip (one project's, or the solution's as a zip of its projects' zips; editable or not; metadata from [package] in twaco.toml).

project.description: Only this project; the whole solution when omitted.

editable.description: extension: whether the entities stay editable once installed.

out.description: The file to write, relative to the solution root.

detail.description: What the package holds; which members it has depends on the action.

projects.description: A solution's extension: each project's package.

name: import
description: Import into the server as Composer's Import/Export does: an export file of the solution (XML, or a zip of them), or a source-control tree in a file repository. A dry run unless dry_run is false: a file's plan lists what it adds and what it replaces; an XML file also preserves configured server-owned parts. Source-control imports and archives cannot preserve them. The server's property values and configuration table rows are kept unless the overwrite flags say otherwise.

file.description: file: relative to the solution root.

path.description: source_control: the tree's folder in it.

server_owned.description: Existing XML entities whose import carries server-owned parts.

parts.description: Owned parts the import carries from the server.

clears.description: Owned parts holding an encrypted value, which the import clears; a deploy hook sets them.

outputSchema.description:
A file's import answers with what it adds, replaces, and preserves; a source-control one
with the server's diff.

name: settings
description: Read the server's subsystem settings (Composer: Browse > Subsystems): list the subsystems, show one with every setting, its value and description, or search every setting by name or description. Read-only; PASSWORD values are never shown.

subsystem.description: show: a subsystem, such as Logging or LoggingSubsystem.

table.description: show: only this table of the subsystem, such as Settings (any case).

text.description: search: part of a setting's name or description.

outputSchema.description: Each action answers with different members; `ok` is the one they share.

name: catalog
description: The repository's offline service catalog: callable services by entity, their parameters, result, description, origin and whether code exists. entity may be Entity.Service (or a service name one entity declares) for one service; body: true adds its script. Summary returns at most 50 services; detail returns all.

entity.description: One entity, full name or its last dotted segment; or Entity.Service, or a service name only one entity declares, for that one service.

project.description: Narrow to one project of the solution.

text.description: Case-insensitive match over service names, parameter names and descriptions; use entity to narrow to one entity.

detail.description: Return everything instead of the summary.

body.description: Include each service's script (body). Needs entity.

name: contract_diff
description: Compare the working tree's public contract with a git revision (against, required). Offline and read-only; the revision must contain its own twaco.toml. Reports breaking and compatible changes, unreadable inputs, and current callers at resolved or structural confidence. Callers outside this repository are invisible. project limits both sides; detail expands the text report. The JSON arrays always contain every change and caller.

against.description: Required git revision to compare with, such as origin/main.

project.description: Limit both sides to this project.

detail.description: Include text with every change and caller instead of the text summary.

name: impact
description: What changing an entity, or one service, property or field of it, would reach: the Things, templates, shapes, mashups and projects that depend on it, directly or through others, each at the strength of its weakest reference (structural: declared in the XML or twaco.toml; resolved: a static name in a script or a mashup binding; review: a string that looks like the name, for a person to judge). Offline and read-only. It cannot see references built at run time or outside the repository; `complete` says whether every input was read and `unreadable` lists what was not. With server: true it also asks the server (read-only) what refers to the entity one step away, in its dependency graph and, for a template or shape, the Things that have it, each marked when the repository does not have it; the server sees structural references only. Summary leaves the chain to each dependent out; detail includes it.

entity.description: Collection/Name, a full name, or its last dotted segment.

member.description: A service, property or field of the entity: ask only about what names it.

depth.description: How many references away to look; omit for no limit.

format.description: dot returns the dependents as a Graphviz graph in `dot`.

detail.description: Return everything instead of the summary.

server.description: Also ask the server what refers to the entity (its dependency graph, and the Things of a template or shape), each marked by whether the repository has it. Read-only; not with format dot.

outputSchema.description: The JSON form and the Graphviz form share the subject and how complete the reading was.

name: trace
description: How each caller uses one service, where impact says only who: for each mashup, what runs the call, what sets each parameter (or that it is unbound, with the default it then gets) and where each result field goes; for each script, the call as written, the variable the result goes in and what the script reads of it (Things["X"].Service() from anywhere, me.Service() from the entity and what inherits it); and what the service itself calls. Offline and read-only; names built at run time are not seen.

service.description: `<Entity>.<Service>`, the entity as Collection/Name, a full name, or its last segment.

defined_in.description: Where the definition was read, when it is inherited.

name: unused
description: Entities nothing reaches: Things, templates, shapes and DataShapes with no chain of references from an entry point (what twaco.toml deploys, every mashup, anything that runs on events, and what `[unused] keep` names). Advisory and read-only: it deletes nothing, and an entity used only from outside the repository (a REST client, a connected system) looks unused, so list those under `[unused] keep`. `complete` says whether every input was read; `keep_unmatched` lists keep patterns that match nothing. With `fields`, instead the fields of service results that mashups bind field by field which no mashup binds or names; a result bound whole is not judged, and a field read by a script, another service or a REST client looks unused.

fields.description: Report the fields of service results mashups bind field by field which no mashup binds or names, instead of entities; cannot be combined with collection or min_confidence.

min_confidence.description: The weakest reference that counts as use; a stronger minimum reports more entities.

detail.description: Return everything instead of the summary.

outputSchema.description: Unused entities, or with `fields` unused DataShape fields; `judged` and `limits` are shared.

name: docs
description: The solution written down from the repository: the projects and their deploy order, how Things, templates and shapes inherit, every service with its signature, the DataShapes with their fields and where they are used, and the references that only look like a name and need a person's judgement. Offline and read-only; it has no dates, so regenerating it and diffing shows what changed. Permissions are not read yet, and references built at run time are not seen; `complete` says whether every input was read. Returns the document as JSON in `document` and as Markdown in `markdown`. Summary gives service and field counts; detail gives every signature and field.

detail.description: Return everything instead of the summary.

name: doctor
description: What resolved, what is reachable and what is missing, before anything else is blamed: twaco's version, the solution and its projects, the entity files, sidecars, .gitignore and secrets git tracks, the baseline, the workspace lock, the profile, and whether the server answers and accepts the credentials. Read-only; works without a solution. ok is false when an item fails.

name: guide
description: Knowledge for working on this solution: twaco's workflow, the ThingWorx platform's verified-live quirks, the service-code reference, and the solution's own AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md and docs/. Search before a live import, a hand-written mashup binding, a configuration-table change, or a service that introspects metadata or touches JSON. list: the topics; search: the best-matching sections; read: a topic (a long one gives its outline) or one section by heading.

action.description: Default: search when text is given, read when a topic is, else list (as `twaco guide`).

text.description: search: words, such as "AddMember group" or "configuration table row replaced".

topic.description: read: a topic id from list or search, such as quirks or docs/DEVELOPER_GUIDE.

section.description: read: a section heading, or a part of it that only one heading has.

sections.description: A topic too long to read whole: its headings.

problems.description: Topics of the solution that could not be read.

outputSchema.description: Each action answers with different members; `ok` is the one they share.

name: help_search
description: Search the ThingWorx Platform help center for the server's version (or another): pages holding every word, best first, with title, path, summary and address. It explains concepts and how-tos; for one service's parameters, the editor types (`types`) are better.

query.description: Words, as in the help's own search box. Code such as Resources["InfoTableFunctions"] is split into its words.

version.description: A help release such as 10.1; default: the server's own.

refresh.description: Download the index again instead of using the cache.

name: help_page
description: Read one ThingWorx Platform help page as Markdown, from a path or address that help_search returned. Long pages: ask for one section by heading; the result lists every heading.

page.description: A path such as ThingWorx/Help/Composer/Things/ThingServices/QueryParameterforQueryServices.html, or its address.

section.description: Only the part under the first heading containing this text.

version.description: A help release such as 10.1; default: the one in the address, else the server's own.

name: javadoc
description: Search or read ThingWorx Platform API Javadoc as Markdown. sdk can name an Extension SDK zip, extracted folder, or Javadoc jar; otherwise TWACO_SDK, then the named profile's sdk, then the public 10.1.0 site is used. refresh is ignored for an SDK. search ranks class and member simple names exact, prefix, then contains. class gives the class description and method summaries; member gives every overload with parameters, returns and throws. service takes a service as a script or path names it (Resources["InfoTableFunctions"].Sort, Things/Name.Service, me.Service, Class.member), finds the class that declares it, looking in the classes it extends, and returns every overload.

name.description: search: a name; class: a simple or qualified class name; service: a service as a script or path names it (Resources["InfoTableFunctions"].Sort, Things/Name.Service, me.Service, Class.member).

member.description: class: return full details for every overload of this member.

sdk.description: An Extension SDK zip, extracted folder, or Javadoc jar. It is read locally and never cached.

profile.description: Profile whose sdk is used when sdk and TWACO_SDK are unset.

declared_in.description: action service: the class whose page documents the member

inherited.description: action service: whether that class is one the reference's class extends

note.description: action service: the named class is not in the Javadoc, and a more general one answered

outputSchema.description: search answers with `results`; class with the class's page.

name: call
description: Call a ThingWorx service. Without dry_run, a service known to only read runs (a platform read such as InfoTableFunctions or GetPropertyValues that the repository does not define, or one twaco.toml [call] read_only lists; the result says read_only) and any other is a dry run; dry_run true always plans, false always calls. A bare target is a Thing; Collection/Name reaches templates, shapes, resources and subsystems.

target.description: Collection/Name, or an entity of the solution by full or last-segment name (Manager), or a platform Thing's name.

dry_run.description: Left out, the call runs only when the service is known to only read (a platform read such as InfoTableFunctions or GetPropertyValues the repository does not define, or one twaco.toml [call] read_only lists) and is otherwise planned; true always plans; false always calls.

with_logs.description: Also return what the call wrote to ScriptLog and ApplicationLog, even when it fails. Waits up to 3 s for late entries. ScriptLog at WARN records no logger.info/debug; see log_level.

detail.description: Return everything instead of the summary.

as.description: Call as this [[test.user]] of twaco.toml, with the profile's test_password; the profile must have allow_test_users. A user in no group that can see the entity gets 404; a wrong password 401.

lang.description: Make the call in this language (de, or a preference list fr,de); only with as. ThingWorx takes a call's language from the user's stored preference, so the test user's preference is set for the call and put back after it.

result.description: A reply that is not an InfoTable, whole, or `void`.

logs.description: With with_logs: the entries logged during the call, or why they could not be read.

read_only.description: Why a call without dry_run ran: "platform" (a built-in platform read) or "twaco.toml" (listed in [call] read_only).

outputSchema.description: A plan names the call; a call that ran answers with its result, summarised by shape.
